title: Establish first accepted third-party benchmark baseline
description: After the materialized-repository runner exists and the first exhaustive scope has human-accepted annotations, run the scanner against the exact pinned checkout and publish the initial component benchmark report. Report recall, label accuracy, correct-label recall, precision only for the accepted exhaustive scope, negative-case pass rate, unread count, denominators, pinned commit, and scanned-file inventory. Route every unmatched finding inside the exhaustive scope to adjudication before publishing final precision. Separate scanner-driven results from any corpus corrections. Add a reproducible command and record the verified baseline in DATAP-b17f92.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
## T0 provisional snapshot — not this issue's acceptance (2026-08-27)

This issue stays open until a **human-accepted** third-party baseline exists.

A provisional proposed-state run was captured locally (see DATAP-b17f92): 150 cases, ~37% recall, 0% label accuracy, 29 unread Hyperswitch `.rs` files. Do not cite as headline metrics.

Blockers before this issue can close:
- Human adjudication (DATAP-c66199)
- Scoring-contract T1 (label aliases + data_items identity) so label accuracy is meaningful
- Persist runs (JSON + Plexus warehouse) so T0/T1/T2 are comparable

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Runner blocker DATAP-53a1e4 is now closed (PR #3 on develop). This baseline is still blocked on DATAP-c66199: no accepted ground truth yet. The 2026-08-27 Plexus corpus Evaluation (DATAP-c65881) was provisional proposed-gold only and does not satisfy this issue.
